content: Compatibility of VariationRestrictionWithSeverity . validBindingTime In case the value of VariationRestrictionWithSeverity . variation is true at both the producer's and the consumer's side, further evaluation of the VariationRe- strictionWithSeverity . validBindingTime attribute is required. The valid- BindingTime attributes at the producer's and the consumer's side are considered compatible if the the set of valid binding times of the producer is a subset of the set of valid binding times of the consumer.
